title: Nike Vomero Premium Men's Road Running Shoes

description.text: Take maximum cushioning to the extreme in the Vomero Premium. Two energy boosting Air Zoom units are surrounded by ultrasoft, responsive ZoomX foam to give you our most comfortable ride yet for everyday road runs.
description.html: Take maximum cushioning to the extreme in the Vomero Premium. Two energy boosting Air Zoom units are surrounded by ultrasoft, responsive ZoomX foam to give you our most comfortable ride yet for everyday road runs.

reviews.comments: Don't get me wrong the shoes are eye catching and the sole thickness does provide some comfort while adding a couple inches to your height but overall I would NOT recommend these shoes at this price point. They squeak and they seem to roll over outward like when you turn your ankle.

Everything they say they are and more! A lot of reviews state they are the most comfortable shoe they’ve tried, I’m a sneakerhead, I’ve got DN8’s, Vapormax’s, literally every air max ever made, even On Cloudmonsters, and these by far, are the most cushioned, comfortable ride I have ever put on my feet! In my opinion the reduced impact from 12-16 hour days on concrete, make them well worth the money.
Great customer service they shipped my shoes fast overall experience was amazing!
This is the most comfortable shoe I’ve ever worn. The color is fire and the feel is like a pillow on your feet.

research.demographic_appeal: runners seeking maximum cushioning and comfort
research.health_benefits: provides excellent shock absorption and joint protection
